findings.finding: The ## Required skills section is only generated on the no-existing-packet else branch. If cand1/cand2/cand3 already exists (cli.go:2449-2457), that file is reused as-is and resolveSynthesisSkillPaths is skipped. After this change a first dispatch generates the section; a stale pre-fix packet in gitignored .lucind/packets/ would not be regenerated. Admission still derives skills from frontmatter, so env delivery would still apply; the body section could remain missing on that reuse path.
